rationale: Moves the editor data plane out of core/view into a new UI-free Pulp module, core/dataplane (pulp::dataplane and pulp::dataplane-audio, namespace pulp::dataplane), so the editor-host contract's VisualPort and ParamPort can be backed by it with no UI library linked. value_source.hpp keeps its path as a forwarding header: it includes <pulp/dataplane/value_source.hpp> and brings each name into pulp::view with a using-declaration, so view code and widgets compile unchanged. The combined re-export carries pulp-dataplane as a temporary mirror unit for one export, so Vellum inherits the moved sources and the forwarders until its view-core binds vellum::value.
